content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text decides a chain-supported dispute over Isaiah 7:14 by separating the challenger's wording point from the defender's application point, so it is exercising the chain-collision assessment K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "'the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' — weighed (a) as requiring the judge to compare the parties' full supported chains rather than one verse's wording or application, or (b) as only barring reliance on one isolated contrary verse; I took it as (a).", "why": "The judge declares the Isaiah 7:14 dispute underdetermined by separating the challenger's wording point from the defender's application point instead of weighing the two chains by footing as K-C requires."}
